images.title: The shelf with one empty place
images.prompt: Photographic 1970s folk-horror film still, 35mm film grain, muted palette of cedar brown, attic-dust beige and faded felt colours (moss, rust, sky, cream) with bone-white thread, warm practical light. A worn pine shelf unit against a log cabin wall, seen straight on in a wide frame, two long shelves in the lower two thirds, each a single tight row of small handmade wool-felt animals with button eyes, bears, rabbits, cats and dogs, shoulder to shoulder. On the upper shelf, right of centre, the row is broken by one conspicuous empty place: bare wood where exactly one toy is missing, a clean toy-sized patch in the grey dust, the neighbours on either side leaning slightly toward it. The upper third of the frame is calm: bare knotty pine wall and faded small-flower wallpaper in soft shadow, left empty. Light rakes from the left, the lamp itself not in frame; beneath the toys a faint amber warmth on the wood, the only saturated colour. Dust, cotton thread, buttons catching light. images.title: The Empty Toy: awake and still
images.prompt: Photographic 1970s folk-horror film still, 35mm film grain, muted palette of cedar brown, attic-dust beige and faded felt colours (moss, rust, sky, cream) with bone-white thread, warm practical light. Morning on a worn pine shelf in a log cabin, seen level with the shelf. At the centre sits one small hand-sewn grey felt CAT, unmistakably a cat: two sharp triangular ears, a long thin tail curled beside it, and mismatched button eyes, one large black and one small pale. A long bone-white thread seam runs down its chest. It sits upright and perfectly still, with a film of grey dust on its head and shoulders. The shelf is covered in grey dust; on either side of the cat two rectangular patches of clean bare wood show where toys once sat. At the far right sit three newer felt toys, a rabbit, a bear and a cat, with a faint amber glow on the wood beneath them, none beneath the grey cat. At the left edge an elderly woman's hand in a moss-green cardigan sleeve holds a feather duster low, well short of the cat, with clear space between. Cool window light. The lower quarter is the calm dark front edge of the shelf. No face of the woman, no text, no lettering, no watermark, no logo

images.title: The Page: down here
images.prompt: Photographic 1970s folk-horror film still, 35mm film grain, muted palette of cedar brown, attic-dust beige and faded felt colours (moss, rust, sky, cream) with bone-white thread. A round stone cellar under a cabin with a low dome, seen from a high angle looking down at the floor. The dark walls are hung with plain cloth embroidered with rows of tiny abstract stitched knots and crosses, almost lost in darkness, no writing. On the stone floor a ring of flat, empty, unstuffed felt animal shapes lies edge to edge like a circle of pressed leaves. Well inside the ring, near its centre, a small hand-sewn grey felt cat with mismatched button eyes and a bone-white chest seam lies limp on its side on the bare stone, alone. A slack bone-white thread trails from a needle beside the cat across the floor to a tall wooden lectern standing at the edge of the ring, on whose slanted top an open book of blank hand-sewn linen pages rests, one new pale page stitched in. One thin shaft of grey light falls from an open trapdoor above onto the cat; no amber glow. The lower quarter is calm bare stone floor, empty, nothing on it. No people, no text, no lettering, no letters, no watermark, no logo
